capability_boundary: A circle does not certify road travel time or a merchant's delivery policy.
No automatic uncovered-area or service-demand optimization is calculated.
WKT input is not parsed by this file viewer.
No simplification tolerance or topology-preserving simplifier is applied.
No separate point list is tested for polygon containment.
No fuel-station search or refuelling-stop optimization is performed.
This is not the proprietary Walk Score metric and does not score pavement, crossings or pedestrian access.
Battery state, elevation, charging locations and energy consumption are not modelled.
No tidal station, tidal harmonic model or tide-height forecast is queried here.
Live weather observations and forecasts are not included.
This workspace does not query air-quality measurements or calculate an AQI.
No star catalogue or sky-chart projection is rendered.
A nearest-coastline search is not performed.
The pole is not selected automatically; enter 90, 0 or −90, 0 as the second endpoint.
A static-image map API URL is not generated.
This workspace does not generate a QR-code image.
This workspace does not calculate a calibrated print scale bar.
No historical map layer or historical boundary date is selected.
